name: Kagura Risa
source:
A sportsman and a slender beauty.
She is cheerful, vivacious, and has a positive mindset.
She is winsome and cheerful. She may look brusque, but she is pure-hearted. She has a lot of problems and is worried about her unreliability as a pillar of the family.
She is a good older sister who takes good care of her younger brother and sister and loves them dearly.
On the other hand, her younger brother always solves the problems in the house.
She still loves Yoshiaki, but it is not in the nature of a man-woman relationship.
(She is convinced of this, but she has a latent longing for him.)

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070827142514/http://www.assemblage.co.jp/asm/carmine/noise/noise_char.html]official site, archived[/url]]
